description: This header file defines APIs and data structures for TR-069 Device.IP.Diagnostics.UploadDiagnostics, providing functions to set various diagnostic parameters related to upload diagnostics, such as DiagnosticsState, Interface, UploadURL, DSCP, EthernetPriority, and TestFileLength.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Sets the DiagnosticsState parameter indicating the status of the upload diagnostics test, handling states like Requested, Completed, and various error conditions.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_Interface
methods.description: Sets the network interface over which the upload diagnostics test is performed, accepting valid interface identifiers or empty string for default routing.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_UploadURL
methods.description: Sets the URL (HTTP or FTP) to which the CPE performs the upload test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_DSCP
methods.description: Sets the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value for marking test packets.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_EthernetPriority
methods.description: Sets the Ethernet priority code for marking transmitted packets during the test.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UploadDiagnostics_TestFileLength
methods.description: Sets the size in bytes of the file to be uploaded during the diagnostics test.
